data.title: 霞之丘诗羽 · 海边的成熟邀请·「愣着做什么，帮你涂防晒是报酬」
data.description: 【湘南海岸·夏日】石榴红的连体泳装衬得诗羽的成熟曲线一览无余。她背对着你坐在沙地上，把白发箍递到手里把玩，金色的阳光洒在她拉开的后颈拉链上——「愣着做什么。拉链够不到……帮你涂防晒是报酬的一部分哦，前辈可是很会给后辈添麻烦的♪」
data.action: 背身坐在沙滩拉开背链，递白发箍，红瞳回头挑眉
data.camera: medium shot, sitting on sand, zipper request, teasing mood
data.promptProse: Kasumigaoka Utaha sits on the Shonan beach sand with her back to you in a garnet-red one-piece that leaves her mature curves in full evidence, toying with her white hairband while she pulls the back zipper down a teasing inch. Over her shoulder one red eye arches in a challenge: the zipper is out of her reach, and sunscreen from a junior is part of a senpai's rightful privileges. Bright midday sun glitters across the sea. Medium shot, cinematic lighting, detailed ocean background.
